A 100,000-hour dataset of first-person video of skilled manual work, recorded by Hub contributors: building sites, workshops, salons, kitchens, shops, warehouses and homes, released in stages. Releases 1 and 2 together have 20,113 hours of RGB + IMU from 21,259 contributors, in LeRobot and MCAP formats.
